messages:
kelsey: Quick FYI — Marta Martinez (contractor) confirmed last day = 2026-04-10 CET. Need to align on benefits end, COBRA-equivalent, SSO deprovision timing, laptop return, and final paycheck/expenses. Who owns what?

jamal: Do contractors on Contractor Plus get COBRA? I thought vendor handled that. cc @lia-benefits

lia-benefits: Confirming Marta is on the 'Redwood Contractor Plus' vendor plan. Vendor feed shows coverage through 2026-04-30. We need to send termination to vendor this week; they'll confirm continuation options (vendor COBRA-equivalent).

adrian-manager: We need Marta to have access for 48h after last day for final doc sign-offs with infra. Can IT allow an exception until 2026-04-12?

it-ops-bot: New ticket IT-2026-451 created: Request temporary access extension for marta.martinez until 2026-04-12. Standard offboard removes SSO end-of-day in user's timezone unless exception approved. To approve, reply with "approve access exception".

linda-finance: Payroll note: final paycheck cutoff for 04/10 term is 2026-04-05. Submit receipts by 2026-04-03 for inclusion in final run. Reimbursements after go to next cycle.

marta: Got it — I'll upload receipts by 4/3. For laptop return: I'm in Lisbon. Do you cover shipping? Last contractor had prepaid label.

linda-finance: We cover prepaid return shipping for international contractors. Use asset returns label and paste tracking here. Address:
Ship to:
Redwood Inference - Asset Returns
c/o Logistics Team
120 Tech Park Ave
Oakland, CA 94607

adrian-manager: I approve access exception for 48h. approve access exception

it-ops-bot: Access extension approved by adrian-manager. IT ticket updated: SSO exception until 2026-04-12 23:59 CET. Note: keys/tokens and 3rd-party service access will be revoked on 2026-04-12 unless listed in exception doc.

lia-benefits: I'll draft and send termination notice to vendor today. Marta — expect vendor email about continuation options within ~7 business days.

kelsey: Action list: 1) lia-benefits sends vendor notice (today) 2) adrian approved access exception (done) 3) IT to execute SSO exception & schedule token revocation (ticket) 4) linda-finance to process payroll/reimbursements if receipts by 4/3 5) Marta to ship laptop and post tracking 6) kelsey to confirm equity/bonus status. Reply to add anything. :thumbsup:

marta: Shipping: DHL TRACK1234567890 — shipped 2026-03-29. Also, I completed vesting last quarter; no outstanding equity questions on my end.

it-ops-bot: Update: IT-2026-451 in-progress. Token rotation and key revoke scheduled for 2026-04-12 12:00 UTC.

kelsey: Closing loop — vendor notified, finance deadline noted, IT scheduled, tracking received, equity check confirmed by Marta. I'll post final confirmation when comp ops replies. Thanks everyone. :heart:
